subject: maths
title: Integration and Areas Under Curves
welcome_lead: Reverse differentiation to find areas, volumes and total quantities.
meta_desc: IBDP Maths adventure on integration, areas under curves and volumes of revolution.
final_note: Integration accumulates - the inverse of differentiation!

concepts.def: ∫ f(x) dx = F(x) + C where F' = f.
∫ from a to b of f(x) dx = F(b) - F(a).
Area = ∫ from a to b of f(x) dx, f ≥ 0.
V = π ∫ y^2 dx about x-axis.
∫ k dx = kx + C for constant k.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Evaluate ∫ from 0 to 2 of 3x^2 dx.

= [x^3] from 0 to 2 = 8 - 0 = 8.

Rotate y = x, 0 ≤ x ≤ 2, about x-axis.

V = π ∫ from 0 to 2 of x^2 dx = π × 8/3 = 8π/3.
